examples: I am grateful for my family.
I am grateful for your help.
We are grateful for the sunny day.

more.def: Feeling or showing thanks for something good.
examples: We were grateful to the neighbors who helped us move.
The lost hikers were grateful to see the rescue team.
She wrote a note to say how grateful she was for the gift.

easy.def: What pulls things down to the ground.
examples: Gravity makes the ball fall down.
Gravity keeps us on the ground.
Without gravity, we would float.

more.def: The force that pulls objects toward the Earth and keeps us on the ground.
examples: Because of gravity, a dropped pencil always falls to the floor.
Gravity pulls the rain down from the clouds.
There is less gravity on the moon than on Earth.
We had a great day.
That is a great idea.
She is a great singer.

more.def: Very good, or much larger or more important than usual.
examples: Our team had a great game and won by a lot.
The Great Wall is one of the longest walls in the world.
A great storm blew across the plains.
The greedy boy took all the cookies.
Do not be greedy. Take just one.
The greedy dog ate the cat's food too.

more.def: Wanting much more of something than you need or than is fair.
examples: The greedy king kept all the gold for himself.
The greedy pirate wanted all the treasure for himself.
It would be greedy to take more than your share.
I am grumpy when I am tired.
The grumpy man did not smile.
My cat is grumpy after a bath.

more.def: Easily annoyed and in a bad mood.
examples: He is always grumpy before he has eaten breakfast.
The grumpy troll would not let anyone cross the bridge.
She felt grumpy because she had slept badly.
